annotations.title: Resolve token symbol to canonical address

description: Resolve an ERC-20 token SYMBOL to its CANONICAL on-chain address from the trusted Ophis token list (the same curated list the swap UI uses). Use this BEFORE quoting or building so you never trade an address taken from chat, the web, or memory: a token can spoof the symbol "USDC" at a scam address, and this fails closed. Returns { found, ambiguous, canonical: {address, decimals, name} | null, matches: [...] }. found=false means no trusted match (do NOT guess: confirm any candidate with get_balances and the user). ambiguous=true means several trusted tokens share the symbol (e.g. native vs bridged); confirm which the user means. Native coins are not returned; resolve the wrapped symbol (e.g. WETH). Read-only.

chainId.description: EVM chain id (use a chainId from list_chains `tradeable`).

symbol.description: Token symbol to resolve, e.g. "USDC" or "WETH".

name: resolve_token
